result.instructions: Tools for CiviCRM, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Find the contact for jane@example.org and show her donations and memberships."; "Which memberships expire in the next 30 days?"; "List the donations over 500 received this month, newest first.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes CiviCRM data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run civicrm_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run civicrm_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run civicrm_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. civicrm_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: civicrm_whoami
tools.title: Get current contact
tools.description: The CiviCRM contact this API key belongs to (contact id, display name, contact type) and how it authenticated. Everything the other tools do is limited to that contact's permissions. GET /civicrm/authx/id, then APIv4 Contact.get.

tools.name: civicrm_search_contacts
tools.title: Search contacts
tools.description: Find contacts (people, organizations, households) by a word in their name, e-mail address or phone number, optionally of one contact type. Trashed contacts are left out. Returns id, display name, type, primary e-mail and phone. APIv4 Contact.get.

query.description: Text to look for in the display name, primary e-mail or primary phone (partial match). Leave empty to list contacts by name.

offset.description: How many records to skip (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_offset.

tools.name: civicrm_get_contact
tools.title: Get contact
tools.description: One contact by id: name, type, job title, source, communication preferences (do not e-mail, opted out, ...), dates, plus all their e-mail addresses, phone numbers and postal addresses. APIv4 Contact.get, Email.get, Phone.get, Address.get.

contact_id.description: CiviCRM contact id (the cid in the contact's URL).

tools.name: civicrm_list_contact_notes
tools.title: List contact notes
tools.description: The notes recorded on one contact (subject, text, who wrote it, when), newest first. APIv4 Note.get.

offset.description: How many records to skip (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_offset.

tools.name: civicrm_list_relationships
tools.title: List contact relationships
tools.description: The relationships of one contact (employee of, spouse of, volunteer for, ...) with the other contact, start and end date and whether it is active. APIv4 Relationship.get.

offset.description: How many records to skip (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_offset.

tools.name: civicrm_list_contributions
tools.title: List contributions
tools.description: Contributions (donations, membership dues, event fees) with contact, amount, currency, financial type, status, payment method, date and source, newest first. Filter by contact, status, financial type, date range and minimum amount. Test contributions are left out. APIv4 Contribution.get.

status.description: Only this status by name, e.g. Completed, Pending, Failed, Cancelled, Refunded.

financial_type.description: Only this financial type by name, e.g. Donation, Member Dues, Event Fee.

date_from.description: Received on or after this date.

date_to.description: Received on or before this date (a plain date includes that whole day).

min_amount.description: Only contributions of at least this amount.

offset.description: How many records to skip (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_offset.

tools.name: civicrm_list_memberships
tools.title: List memberships
tools.description: Memberships with contact, membership type, status (New, Current, Grace, Expired, ...), join, start and end date. Filter by contact, status, type, or those ending before a date (renewal follow-up). Test memberships are left out. APIv4 Membership.get.

status.description: Only this status by name, e.g. Current, Grace, Expired, Cancelled.

membership_type.description: Only this membership type by name, e.g. General.

ends_before.description: Only memberships that end on or before this date.

ends_after.description: Only memberships that end on or after this date.

offset.description: How many records to skip (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_offset.

tools.name: civicrm_list_events
tools.title: List events
tools.description: Events with title, type, start and end date, whether active and public, maximum participants and summary. Upcoming events first when upcoming_only is set. Template events are left out. APIv4 Event.get.

title.description: Only events whose title contains this text.

upcoming_only.description: Only events that have not ended yet (start date today or later).

offset.description: How many records to skip (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_offset.

tools.name: civicrm_list_participants
tools.title: List event participants
tools.description: Event registrations with event, contact, status (Registered, Attended, Cancelled, ...), role, registration date and fee. Filter by event, contact or status. Test registrations are left out. APIv4 Participant.get.

status.description: Only this participant status by name, e.g. Registered, Attended, Cancelled.

offset.description: How many records to skip (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_offset.

tools.name: civicrm_list_activities
tools.title: List activities
tools.description: Activities (meetings, phone calls, e-mails, follow-ups, ...) with type, subject, status, date and details, newest first. With contact_id: the activities that contact took part in, with their role (source, target or assignee). Otherwise all activities, optionally of one type or status. APIv4 ActivityContact.get / Activity.get.

contact_id.description: Only activities this contact is involved in.

activity_type.description: Only this activity type by name, e.g. Meeting, Phone Call, Email, Follow up.

status.description: Only this status by name, e.g. Scheduled, Completed, Cancelled.

date_to.description: On or before this date (a plain date includes that whole day).

offset.description: How many records to skip (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_offset.

tools.name: civicrm_list_cases
tools.title: List cases
tools.description: Cases (CiviCase) with subject, case type, status and dates. With contact_id: the cases that contact is a client of. Needs the CiviCase component to be enabled. APIv4 CaseContact.get / Case.get.

contact_id.description: Only cases of this client contact.

status.description: Only this case status by name, e.g. Open, Resolved. Applied when no contact_id is given.

offset.description: How many records to skip (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_offset.

tools.name: civicrm_list_groups
tools.title: List groups
tools.description: Contact groups (mailing lists, static groups, smart groups) with title, description, visibility and type. APIv4 Group.get.

title.description: Only groups whose title contains this text.

offset.description: How many records to skip (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_offset.

tools.name: civicrm_list_group_contacts
tools.title: List group members
tools.description: The members of one static group (or the groups one contact belongs to): contact, group and membership status (Added, Removed, Pending). Smart groups are computed by CiviCRM and not listed here. APIv4 GroupContact.get.

offset.description: How many records to skip (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_offset.

tools.name: civicrm_get_fields
tools.title: Describe an entity's fields
tools.description: The fields of one CiviCRM entity (Contact, Contribution, Event, ...) including custom fields: name, label, data type, whether required, and the allowed options for a pick-list field. Use it to find the right field names for civicrm_query and the right option names for the filters and write tools. APIv4 <Entity>.getFields.

field.description: Only this field, with its options (e.g. contribution_status_id).

action.description: The action the fields are for (default get).

tools.name: civicrm_list_entities
tools.title: List API entities
tools.description: The APIv4 entities this CiviCRM site offers (Contact, Contribution, Event, plus those of installed extensions), with a short description. Use the names with civicrm_get_fields and civicrm_query. APIv4 Entity.get.

search.description: Only entities whose name or title contains this text.

tools.name: civicrm_query
tools.title: Query any entity
tools.description: Read records of ANY CiviCRM entity with APIv4 Entity.get: choose fields, filter, sort and page. Use civicrm_list_entities and civicrm_get_fields for the names. Field names may be joined (`contact_id.display_name`, `email_primary.email`) or ask for an option's text (`status_id:label`). Examples: entity Tag; entity Campaign with where [{field:'is_active',op:'=',value:true}]; entity Contribution with select ['id','total_amount'] and where [{field:'total_amount',op:'>=',value:1000}]. Read-only; credential fields and system entities (settings, payment processors, mailings, users) are refused.

where.description: Filters, all of which must match.

op.description: Operator. IS NULL, IS NOT NULL, IS EMPTY and IS NOT EMPTY take no value; IN, NOT IN and BETWEEN take a list.

offset.description: How many records to skip (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_offset.

tools.name: civicrm_create_contact
tools.title: Create contact
tools.description: WRITE: creates ONE new contact (an individual, organization or household) and optionally its first e-mail address and phone number. Does not check for duplicates: search first with civicrm_search_contacts. Sends nothing. APIv4 Contact.create, Email.create, Phone.create.

source.description: Where this contact came from (free text).

email.description: First e-mail address (stored as the primary one).

phone.description: First phone number (stored as the primary one).

tools.name: civicrm_update_contact
tools.title: Update contact
tools.description: WRITE: changes basic fields of ONE existing contact (name, job title, source, preferred language) and/or its communication preferences (do not e-mail, do not phone, do not mail, do not SMS, opted out of bulk mail). Only the fields you give are changed. Setting a do-not flag to false re-enables contact the person may have declined, so only do that on the person's request. APIv4 Contact.update.

is_opt_out.description: Opted out of ALL bulk mailings.

tools.name: civicrm_add_contact_note
tools.title: Add contact note
tools.description: WRITE: adds ONE note to a contact's record, written by the contact this API key belongs to. Sends nothing. APIv4 Note.create.

contact_id.description: CiviCRM contact id the note is about.

tools.name: civicrm_log_activity
tools.title: Log activity
tools.description: WRITE: records ONE activity (a meeting, phone call, e-mail, follow-up, ...) with one or more contacts. It only STORES the record: an activity of type Email does not send an e-mail. Added by the contact this API key belongs to unless source_contact_id is given. APIv4 Activity.create.

activity_type.description: Activity type by name, e.g. Meeting, Phone Call, Email, Follow up (see civicrm_get_fields Activity, field activity_type_id).

with_contact_ids.description: The contact(s) the activity is with.

status.description: Status by name, e.g. Completed (default), Scheduled, Cancelled.

activity_date_time.description: When it happened or will happen (default now).

source_contact_id.description: Who added it (default: the API key's own contact).

tools.name: civicrm_record_contribution
tools.title: Record contribution
tools.description: WRITE: records ONE contribution (a donation, a payment received elsewhere) for a contact. It only STORES the financial record: no card is charged, no receipt is e-mailed, and the amount shows up in CiviCRM's reports and the contact's giving history. Check civicrm_list_contributions first to avoid a duplicate. APIv4 Contribution.create.

contact_id.description: CiviCRM contact id of the donor.

total_amount.description: Amount, in the site's currency unless currency is given.

financial_type.description: Financial type by name, e.g. Donation, Member Dues, Event Fee, Campaign Contribution.

status.description: Contribution status by name: Completed (default), Pending, ...

payment_method.description: Payment method by name, e.g. Check, Cash, Credit Card, EFT.

currency.description: ISO currency code (default: the site's default).

trxn_id.description: Your own reference, e.g. a check number or bank reference.

tools.name: civicrm_create_membership
tools.title: Create membership
tools.description: WRITE: gives ONE contact a membership of a type. CiviCRM works out the dates and status from the type unless you give dates. It does NOT record a payment (use civicrm_record_contribution for that) and sends nothing. APIv4 Membership.create.

membership_type.description: Membership type by name, e.g. General (see civicrm_get_fields Membership, field membership_type_id).

start_date.description: Start date (default: calculated by the type).

end_date.description: End date (default: calculated by the type).

tools.name: civicrm_add_contact_to_group
tools.title: Add contact to group
tools.description: WRITE: adds ONE contact to ONE static group. If the group is used as a mailing list, the contact will receive future mailings sent to it, so only add people who agreed. Sends nothing by itself. Adding a contact who is already in the group changes nothing; a contact who was removed from it (or is pending) is set back to Added. APIv4 GroupContact.save matched on group and contact.

tools.name: civicrm_register_participant
tools.title: Register participant
tools.description: WRITE: registers ONE contact for ONE event (a participant record). It does not check the event's capacity or fee, does not take payment and sends no confirmation e-mail. APIv4 Participant.create.

status.description: Participant status by name: Registered (default), Attended, Pending from pay later, ...

role.description: Role by name: Attendee (default), Volunteer, Host, Speaker.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with CiviCRM
prompts.description: What you can do with CiviCRM here, with example requests to try.
